gitCommit.subject: PR1b — pv9 polish: role badge, primitive a11y, member/invite forms (#246)
gitCommit.body:
PR1b — pv9 polish: role badge, primitive a11y, member/invite forms (#246)

* plan: PR1b pv9 polish (RoleBadge, primitive a11y, member/invite, nvj e2e)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(members): RoleBadge over existing Badge variants; drop tier-ramp-for-identity (purses-c0w)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* a11y(error): ErrorMessage announces via role=alert; de-dupe ProfileForm wrapper (purses-na0a)

* a11y(textarea): label + error association + focus-visible (completes purses-1qor)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(textarea): cover explicit-id branch (review fold)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* a11y(input): error association + focus-visible (PR1a review folds)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(invite): clear success timer on unmount + announce via role=status (purses-th14)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(e2e): members + invitations spec (purses-nvj)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(items): reconcile item-detail delete-control test to photos:write contract (spec §5.5); confirm any-curator coverage (§5.4)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* ui: focus-visible consistency, RoleBadge type/test, InviteForm persistent live region (pv9 PR1b review)

FIX 1 (a11y): move error ring + border-transparent overrides from :focus to
:focus-visible in Input and Textarea, so an errored field under pointer focus keeps
a visible boundary (red border no longer erased without a ring to replace it).

FIX 2: narrow RoleBadge prop to "owner" | "curator" (matches MembershipRole);
add curator-side regression guards and broaden tier-absence to the full ramp.

FIX 3 (a11y/UX): keep InviteForm always mounted with a persistent role=status live
region (announces reliably), clear email + allow immediate re-invite on success,
rounded-lg -> rounded-control. Tests updated; drop dead console.error spy, keep
getTimerCount() leak guard.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* chore(graphify): refresh graph for PR1b (RoleBadge, primitive a11y)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(screenshots): members surface shows RoleBadge via seedMembersScenario (purses-c0w)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
